The Leagues Cup intensity reached a fever pitch on August 8, 2026 , as Club Tigres and Minnesota United faced off in a highly anticipated mid-summer battle. With both sides looking to make a statement in the competition, the atmosphere was electric from the opening whistle. Tactical Battle in the Opening Periods From the start of the match , Club Tigres looked to assert their dominance at home. While the first half featured a disciplined defensive display from Minnesota United , the home side managed to find an early breakthrough to lead the proceedings. Every player on the pitch felt the weight of the occasion, as the tactical chess match limited clear-cut opportunities for the visitors to claw their way back into the game before the break. Helinho Doubles the Advantage As the second half progressed, the pressure from the Mexican side finally told. In the 64th minute, Helinho delivered a moment of magic to double the lead. His clinical goal made it 2-0, providing Club Tigres with a crucial cushion. The momentum shifted heavily in favor of the hosts, as Minnesota United struggled to retain possession and create any meaningful chance to test the opposition goalkeeper. Vinas Puts the Result Beyond Doubt With the clock ticking down and the result looking increasingly secure, Club Tigres refused to take their foot off the gas. In the final moments of stoppage time (90+3'), F. Vinas capitalized on a defensive lapse to slot home the third goal of the night. The 3-0 victory was a statement of intent in this sports spectacle, showcasing the depth and clinical finishing of a Tigres side that remains a formidable force in the tournament.
